result.summary: Verdict FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (feature/binary-config-serve-20260930). Scope: CLI grammar, argument ambiguity, repeats/missing values/unknown flags, defaults, backward-compatible status flags. 3 findings, none critical/high: (1) MEDIUM src/cli/arguments.ts:48 - value() accepts an empty string, so `status --url ""` counts as unset and silently falls back to SWARMFORGE_URL or default 127.0.0.1:8787 (regression vs baseline 5672ead). (2) LOW same line - a flag in a value position is consumed as the value, so `serve --config --check-config` runs a normal serve with a bogus config path (no state created, misleading error); the action position already guards this at arguments.ts:110. (3) LOW arguments.ts:144-145 - --version/--help discard trailing args; -h/-V undocumented. Repeats, defaults and old status flags otherwise unchanged; Bun 1.4.2 targeted tests pass (commands 15/15, cli 2/2). Artifacts: .swarmforge/artifacts/review.md + findings.json.
result.details:
Reproduced on a disposable detached checkout at the exact target (/tmp/rev39/target, git rev-parse HEAD verified) with official Bun 1.4.2 in /tmp; /workspace/repo left clean at its assigned baseline 5672ead.

F1 MEDIUM (reproduced): value() only rejects an exhausted iterator, so "" is a legal value. `status --url "" --json` -> 'Unable to connect...' exit 1, i.e. it attempted the default endpoint; with SWARMFORGE_URL set the empty override is discarded entirely. Trace: arguments.ts:66 -> overrides -> setValue empty=unset (load.ts:662) -> url ?? DEFAULT_CLIENT_URL (load.ts:871). `--config ""`/`--env-file ""` anchor to cwd and report EISDIR. Baseline 5672ead refused an empty value. Not covered by tests/commands.test.ts:227-238,295-306 (only absent values).

F2 LOW (reproduced): `serve --config --check-config` -> 'Config file not found: <cwd>/--check-config' exit 1; `serve --env-file --check-config` -> env-file-not-found; `status --url --json` -> 'Client endpoint must use http or https: --json'. checkConfig stays false so the documented dry-run guarantee (cli.ts:52-53) never applies; correct flag orders work. Verified no database/lock/listener created. tests/commands.test.ts:724 only exercises the correct order.

F3 LOW (reproduced in probe): --version/-V/--help ignore trailing args, e.g. ['-V','--nonsense'] and ['--version','status'] -> {kind:'version'}, exit 0.

Also noted, not defects: repeats are last-wins for --url/--config (undocumented), --env-file accumulates as documented; no --flag=value form and no `--` terminator; scheme validation moved to resolveClientSettings with behaviour preserved; config subcommand refuses missing/flag/unknown/extra actions.

Limitations: Linux/Bun only, no full suite (whole-suite reviewer's scope), no packaging build; the silently-started-server variant of F2 and the live wrong-server output of F1 were not executed end-to-end. Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md, /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/findings.json; logs in /workspace/.swarmforge/logs.

Logs: /workspace/.swarmforge/logs/rev39-commands-test.log, /workspace/.swarmforge/logs/rev39-cli-test.log.

warnings: Snapshot bun is 1.3.14 and cannot read this lockfile; official Bun 1.4.2 was installed under /tmp/rev39 and the lockfile was not rewritten.

Review was performed in a disposable clone at /tmp/rev39/target (target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895); /workspace/repo remains at the assigned baseline and clean, so git.commit above is the baseline, not the target.
Finding 2's silently-started-server variant was not executed end to end (needs a file literally named --check-config); it is code-evidenced.
Findings 1 and 2 share one root cause in value() and can be fixed together.
result.followup_reason: Two actionable parser defects in src/cli/arguments.ts:48-53 (value()): an empty flag value is silently ignored (MEDIUM - `status --url ""` targets the wrong endpoint, a regression from baseline 5672ead) and a flag in a value position is consumed as the value (LOW - `serve --config --check-config` silently voids the documented no-state dry run). Recommend rejecting empty and leading-'-' tokens in value(), mirroring the existing guard at arguments.ts:110, plus adding the two parser cases to tests/commands.test.ts. Finding 3 (--version/--help ignoring trailing args) is minor.
